HOSTING_MEMORY_CODES.doc: The hosting codes of the memory dimension: hosting.memory.*, what a qualifier, a host or the console read of a plugin's measured memory against a host's budget, by code, never by prose.

memoryAboveCeiling.doc: the measured figure passes the host's budget for one instance or for all its plugins; the params name the figure, the ceiling, and whether the ceiling is provisional

text.en: This plugin’s measured memory is above the host’s budget. Raise the budget, or use a plugin that uses less memory.

memoryUnmeasured.doc: no figure at the host's rate and quantum, so the plugin is not known to fit; a missing figure never reads as fitting

text.en: This plugin’s memory has not been measured at the host’s rate and quantum, so it is not known to fit. Measure it before trusting that it fits.

memoryWithinCeiling.doc: the measured figure fits a budget that was itself measured on that kind of host

text.en: This plugin’s measured memory fits a budget that was itself measured on this kind of host.

memoryWithinProvisionalCeiling.doc: the measured figure is under a budget not yet measured on that kind of host, so this says the figure and the ceiling, not that the plugin fits

text.en: This plugin’s measured memory is under a budget that has not yet been measured on this kind of host. This is not a guarantee that it fits, only that it is under that provisional budget.
